input.summary:
H2 lobby and stair hall is furnished in parts/room-5.mjs: a florist's barrel stand with pink tulip and azalea pots at the front, two dark oak table-and-chair sets (front and back), a barrel by the rear door, and hanging lanterns at y 7. Walkable (36/36 cells reachable), 0 dark cells, min light 7.
Front door, rear door, keeper's door, stair foot and the x 22 lane all stay clear. make.sh produces a whole build.nbt with 22 placed, no REFUSED writes and no off-palette blocks.
Not built: the sill flower pots (no sills in this box); the room check still reports 3 dim cells at 7, which I left alone rather than stand a lantern in the lane.

waste.what: Worked out the light levels by hand from the room tool's output: the tool's lamp suggestions use file-frame y (world y + 5), which is not documented, so I had to infer which coordinates to hang lanterns at.
waste.cost: about 4 check/adjust rounds, 6 lantern positions tried
waste.tool: mcd room should print lamp spots in world y (the rooms.json frame) and state the frame it uses; or print a hang-at-ceiling option per dim cell.

waste.what: Wrote the furniture as six layers of 16 rows by hand, with a sparse z-to-row map helper I wrote locally to fill the empty rows.
waste.cost: one layer helper, about 90 lines of text for a 3x16 room
waste.tool: a layers-from-list helper in the build library: layersFrom(g, origin, legend, [[x,y,z,block], ...]) so a furnisher lists only the furniture cells, not whole text rows.

waste.what: Checked by hand which cells the stair and walls occupy (plan blanks at z 13 and the stair foot), instead of reading them from the plan.
waste.tool: mcd plan could mark stair-owned cells with a distinct character (e.g. 'S') and list the free-standing lamp and furniture cells the walk requires.

companions.task: Place the hanging lanterns and tune the last 3 dim cells at z 15..18 against the stair well, which needs a ceiling-fixed light my box does not have (a lantern on the stair block or a candle on the barrel).
Put the flower pots on the front window sills of the florist house, which sit outside this box, so the sill pots match the pots inside.

left: 3 floor cells at z 15, 16 and 18 (x 24) read light 7 (dim, not dark); the tool's only suggestion there is a floor lantern in the x 22 lane, which I did not place. A ceiling-fixed light over the stair well is impossible because the well is open at y 8.
Sill flower pots (from the brief's 'pots of plants on the sills') are not built here: this box has no sills, so they belong to the frontage part.
plan.md's checklist and elements.md were not ticked: no element item is wholly within this room part (the lit-interior item belongs to the lighting part).
